description: Cogitate (2025): 25 of 657 posterior iEEG electrodes showed sustained activity tracking stimulus duration, 12 independent of category and 13 category-specific, passing the preregistered IIT duration criterion. Only 8 of 53 face-selective electrodes were sustained, and orientation was not sustained.
limitations: One adversarial study of visual consciousness with suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts. Tests only the predictions both teams preregistered.

sources.quote: In posterior cortex ROIs, 25 electrodes (out of 657) measured sustained activity tracking stimulus duration

We found information about conscious content in visual, ventrotemporal and inferior frontal cortex, with sustained responses in occipital and lateral temporal cortex reflecting stimulus duration, and content-specific synchronization between frontal and early visual areas.
